app.name: RigorGraph
app.tagline: Turn AI research into auditable claim-evidence graphs.
app.disclaimer: RigorGraph checks workflow integrity and traceability. It does not establish absolute truth or replace expert review.

help.root:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] [--version] COMMAND

Options:
  --version  Show the installed version

Commands:
  quickstart Create a first DRAFT claim and offline report
  init       Initialize a project without overwriting files
  claim      Add research claims
  evidence   Add scoped evidence
  verify     Record independent verification
  audit      Check graph and evidence integrity
  report     Generate an offline four-language report
  demo       Create a math, benchmark, or invalid demo

Languages: en, zh-TW, zh-CN, ja
help.quickstart:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] quickstart [PATH] --statement TEXT --author NAME [--type TYPE] [--claim-id ID] [--name NAME] [--open]

Create one real DRAFT claim in its original language and a self-contained offline report. No evidence or VERIFIED status is fabricated.
help.init:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] init [PATH] [--name NAME]

Initialize rigorgraph.yaml and empty state files without overwriting existing content.
help.claim:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] claim COMMAND

Commands:
  add CLAIM.json --path PROJECT
help.claim.add:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] claim add CLAIM.json [--path PROJECT]

Add one DRAFT or PROPOSED claim.
help.evidence:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] evidence COMMAND

Commands:
  add EVIDENCE.json --path PROJECT
help.evidence.add:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] evidence add EVIDENCE.json [--path PROJECT]

Add one scoped evidence record.
help.verify:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] verify CLAIM_ID --file REVIEW.json [--path PROJECT]

Record an independent ACCEPT, REJECT, or UNCERTAIN outcome.
help.audit:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] audit [PATH] [--json] [--fail-on LEVEL]

Check schemas, links, cycles, independence, evidence types, paths, and hashes.
help.report:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] report [PATH] [-o FILE] [--open]

Generate a self-contained offline HTML report with four-language switching.
help.demo:
Usage: rigorgraph [--lang LANGUAGE] demo [PATH] [--scenario math|benchmark|invalid] [--open]

Create a reproducible demonstration project and offline report.
